release_notes:
Fix auto-update download failure in encrypted/Docker containers.

The update download was failing with "Network error during download" in the
encrypted container (8082) because admincp/versionfiles/ required webserver
write permissions. When mkdir/fopen failed silently, cURL wrote binary zip
data to stdout instead of a file, corrupting the JSON response.

Fixes:
- Move the update working directory to sys_get_temp_dir() — always writable
  regardless of web root permissions in Docker or restricted environments
- Guard fopen() return value and return a clear JSON error instead of corrupting
  the response when the directory cannot be written
- ob_start() at script top + ob_clean() after headers to prevent any PHP
  warning or notice from leaking into the JSON response
- ini_set('max_execution_time', 0) alongside set_time_limit(0) to cover
  PHP-FPM environments where only one of the two is honoured
